brief: Two-storey Classical Revival brick house, dark purplish-brown brick with pale limestone trim: a low hipped roof with wide boxed eaves, and a projecting centre entrance pavilion of banded stone piers carrying a tall round arch (with a hanging lantern) under its own small hipped roof. Tall round-arched upper windows and big plate-glass lower windows; a rear two-storey wing with arched windows. Broad stepped terrace of black and white slabs up to the door; somewhat neglected, grass and saplings creeping up.
